Pangram's web app: the whole section reads 100% Human (1,034 words scanned, 22:11:41 UTC on 10-09, batch 184g), and every paragraph passes alone or beside a neighbor that passes alone. It's in the article-so-far page as a candidate.

What changed after your 22:08 message: your P13 is in (it passes alone and in the section), P8 says "the Good Government Juntas (Boards)" at the first mention as you asked (it passes alone), and P7 keeps "the closest thing to a whole example" under your ruling.

Your ruling went into the reviewers, not just into P7: the trace brief now says conversational wording isn't a shift, and every SHIFT has to name what an ordinary reader would now wrongly believe (logic stays strict: "OR is not ALSO"). Re-run on the five paragraphs that still had kept findings (P2, P4, P7, P15, P16), it called all five OK (trace H), so those findings are cleared.

Still open, both from the stance check and both about your own paragraphs (on the P9 row): its question about P9 and P11 against "When Somebody Has to Go", and the contradiction it found already in the published text.
"benefitted" in your P13 is a standard spelling, not a typo, so it stays.

rows.article: After a long internal review, in 2023
notes: Yours, unchanged. Your link sits on "new arrangement".

The stance check (d7) asks, as information, not a fix: your P9 says power "had crept up and consolidated itself at higher levels" and your P11 calls that a degeneration they reversed, while the later section "When Somebody Has to Go" still offers the Zapatistas as proof that "autonomous institutions can review local power without becoming the state". After 2023, which Zapatista body does that reviewing?

It also found the tension already in the published text: section 9 put the coordinating levels beneath the communities, and the later section cites the Zapatistas as a layer that reviews local power. Your P9 makes it sharper. My opinion: one clause, here or in the later section, would settle it. Which body does the reviewing now is your call; I'm not sure of their current structure.
